_comment: Per-env NON-SECRET config for the egpt prod service (the podcast microservice re-homed from daita-ssgpod on 2026-09-29) (WS-V1-PURGE data-plane caller-auth, CEO-D-2026-06-02-APP-MICROSERVICE-IS-CLI-CLIENT-WALLET-SIG). Loaded by @descix/cloud-core _loadEnvDefaults() BEFORE Secret Manager and BEFORE defaults-config.json; the deploy staging bundle (buildSdkAppBundle step 6) merges the Cloud base per-env layer first, then this app file wins. DEVELOPER_WALLET_ADDRESS is the app owner's PUBLIC wallet (the developer the microservice authenticates AS via reconnect_by_wallet); it is NON-secret and belongs here. The matching DEVELOPER_SIGNATURE is a SECRET, provisioned in its own Secret Manager secret, whose name the deploy lane derives from this service's app_id, and mounted as env DEVELOPER_SIGNATURE by that lane — NEVER put a signature value in this checked-in file. CORE_API_URL overrides the env-invariant localhost default so the developer-identity api-client reaches the PROD core broker.
